chapter: Back in New York: Heard and Dizzy
title: Claude Hopkins at the new Zanzibar with Nat King Cole's trio
summary: With Claude Hopkins and lead altoist George James he played for Bill Robinson and on Nat Cole's first New York engagement.

story.theme_name: Medicine shows, minstrels, circuses and the black theater circuit
story.community_name: On the road with minstrel, carnival and tent shows

blocks.x: Was it with the Claude Hopkins... I mean was he billed with them?

No, he had a trio. He was a star. He was on stage. That was a great experience, being with Claude Hopkins. You know I've seen him several times years later. I even got J.J. Johnson to do I think it was a couple of things for the band. Claude Hopkins bought music all the time. Yeah, sure. You know he played fine piano, you know. Yeah.
So what year have we gotten to now, you've come back from Boston...
We're in '45 now, gettin' ready to go into '46.
